hints.title: Root and Left Subtree Root Location
hints.text: The first value in preorder is the root, and the second value is the root of the left subtree.

hints.title: Postorder Subtree Size Boundary
hints.text: Locate the left subtree root value within postorder. Its position plus one gives the exact number of nodes in the left subtree.

hints.title: Segment Partition Recursion
hints.text: Partition preorder and postorder slices into left and right subtrees based on the computed left size, then recursively construct both children.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Recursive slicing and subtree boundary extraction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Assuming fixed binary tree layouts without matching postorder positions leads to misassigned subtrees.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Call stack and slice copies require O(N) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use preorder[1] to identify the left child and find its index in postorder.
